text: Chhach (lassi) is the watery liquid left when diluted dahi is churned for makkhan. With an equal volume of water, about 80% of the dahi's acid and nearly all its microflora wash out into the chhach.

links.name: Halder et al., J Food Sci Technol (makkhan review)
